title: "Dashboard"

  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
    source: embed
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

library(htmlwidgets)
```

```{r}
data("ny_noaa")

noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |>
  mutate(
    year = year(date),
    month = month(date, label = TRUE),
    day = day(date),
    prcp = prcp / 10,
    tmax = as.numeric(tmax) / 10,
    tmin = as.numeric(tmin) / 10,) |>
  select(id, date, year, month, prcp, snow, tmax, tmin) |>
  filter(
    year >= 2005,
    id == "USW00094728",
    !is.na(tmax),
    !is.na(tmin))
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A - Max Temperature (C) in Central Park Station in Every Month

```{r}
noaa_df |>
  plot_ly(
    y = ~tmax, x = ~month, color = ~month, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temperature (C)"),
         xaxis = list(title = "Month"))
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart B - Snowfall (mm) in Central Park Station, 2005-2010

```{r}
noaa_df |>
  filter(!is.na(snow), snow > 0) |>
  count(year) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~year, y = ~n, color = ~factor(year), type = "bar", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Snowfall (mm)"),
         xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
         showlegend = FALSE)
```

### Chart C - Minimum vs Maximum Temp (C) in Central Park Station over Time (years)

```{r}
noaa_df |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Date: ", date, "\nTmax: ", tmax, "C\nTmin: ", tmin, "C")) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~tmin, y =~tmax, color = ~month, text = ~text_label, alpha = .5,
          type = "scatter", mode = "markers") |>
  layout(yaxis = list(title = "Minimum Temp (C)"),
         xaxis = list(title = "Maximum Temp (C)"))
```
